system_note: Billed line: revenue_code 0192, 18 days, DOS range 2026-05-12 -> 2026-06-08. Review of the clinical record shows consistent, documented therapy minutes that support a therapy-based per-diem (0192) for 2026-05-12 through 2026-05-27 (daily PT entries of ~90 minutes plus OT where documented; see citations below). The facility did NOT provide explicit per-diem level statements on any dates (get_per_diem_level_notes rows are null), which is acceptable when daily minutes meet the billed level. However, the therapy-session extract and medical record notes returned in this review include documented PT/OT sessions only through 2026-05-27; there are no therapy-session entries returned for 2026-05-28 through 2026-06-08 to substantiate billing 0192 on those later dates. Therefore the record supports revenue code 0192 for 2026-05-12 through 2026-05-27 (16 days) but does not support the billed 0192 level for the remaining billed days within the claimed DOS range. Adjustment: reduce revenue code 0192 units from 18 to 16 (supported DOS 2026-05-12-2026-05-27). Evidence relied on: H&P admission stating patient admitted for "skilled PT, OT and nursing services" (H&P, p.8); Interdisciplinary Plan showing PT/OT frequency and plan (Interdisciplinary Plan of Care, p.10-11); PT evaluation certifying care 05/12/2026-06/11/2026 and treatment frequency (Physical Therapy, p.18-19); daily PT progress notes documenting ~90 minutes of skilled PT (examples: Physical Therapy 05/13, p.24; Physical Therapy 05/22, p.42). The per-diem-level extraction explicitly shows level_determination_statement = null on dates when no explicit facility-level exception was recorded (get_per_diem_level_notes result). Because no therapy-session documentation was returned for 05/28-06/08, those dates cannot be sustained as therapy-level (0192) per-diem days in this audit. Reviewed revenue line 2 (billed revenue code 0191) for claim MR_SNF_09 covering 2026-05-12 to 2026-06-08. Available clinical documentation shows multiple days with high therapy minutes (examples: PT 90 minutes + OT 60 minutes on 2026-05-12 and repeating through 2026-05-27), and the facility did not record per-diem-level exception statements for the dates queried (per-diem note entries are null). Policy (fallback reference guide in dataset) defines skilled need as requiring licensed nursing or therapy staff and lists a required prior qualifying hospital stay to establish the skilled need; it also identifies 0191 as a standard per-diem code (0191 = skilled nursing). However, two key evidentiary gaps prevent a full determination for the entire billed date range: 1) The raw daily therapy rows retrieved only include explicit therapy-session entries through 2026-05-27; there are no retrieved daily therapy-session rows for 2026-05-28 through 2026-06-08, so the audit cannot verify therapy minutes for every billed date in the range. (See cited daily service rows.) 2) The payer-specific SNF guideline for Aetna Medicare Advantage was not available in the dataset; the reviewer fell back to a payer-agnostic reference that also requires confirmation of a qualifying prior inpatient hospital stay to establish skilled coverage. No documentation of a qualifying hospital stay was returned in the retrieved rows, so the required coverage precondition cannot be confirmed from the record provided. Because the audit must examine every billed date and confirm plan-specific admission criteria, and because the retrievals do not include therapy-session documentation for 2026-05-28 through 2026-06-08 nor a qualifying hospital stay, there is insufficient evidence in the material provided to determine whether the billed 0191 per-diem level is supported for the entire 2026-05-12 to 2026-06-08 range. If the provider supplies the missing items (therapy notes/minutes for 2026-05-28 through 2026-06-08, the qualifying hospital discharge/admission documentation, and the payer-specific per-diem guideline if available), the auditor can complete a definitive day-by-day determination. Cited items used in this determination are listed below (verbatim excerpts): - Therapy session entries showing daily minutes (examples): {"service_date": "2026-05-12", "note_title": "Physical Therapy", "revenue_code": "0421", "minutes": 90, "billable_units": 6} ; {"service_date": "2026-05-12", "note_title": "Occupational Therapy", "revenue_code": "0431", "minutes": 60, "billable_units": 4}. - Per-diem-level extraction result for the claim showing null level determinations on each date (example row): {"service_date": "2026-05-12", "level_determination_statement": null} and the retrieval note: "level_determination_statement is null on a date when the daily note doesn't state an explicit per-diem-level exception for it - that does NOT by itself mean the day is unsupported; it commonly means the billed level's own minute threshold was met that day, so the facility had no exception to document. A non-null statement is the facility's own basis for downcoding that specific date." - Reference guide policy text (fallback used because payer-specific guideline was not available): "A prior inpatient hospital stay of the length required by the plan, immediately preceding SNF admission, that establishes the skilled need."; "A service that requires the involvement of licensed nursing or therapy staff, and could not be safely or effectively provided by non-skilled caregivers."; and "Standard billing codes for the four SNF per-diem levels of care referenced in these guidelines: 0191 (skilled nursing), 0192 (rehabilitation therapy), 0193 (sub-acute), 0194 (weanable ventilator management)." Next recommended provider submissions to allow a final, date-by-date determination: (1) therapy documentation (session notes and minutes) for 2026-05-28 through 2026-06-08, (2) the hospital discharge/transfer documentation showing the prior inpatient stay that established the skilled need, (3) the facility's MDS and care plan covering the billed period, and (4) the payer-specific per-diem guideline (Aetna Medicare Advantage) if available.

rationale_letter: Re: Audit determination for MR_SNF_09 - revenue code 0192 (billed 18 days; 2026-05-12 through 2026-06-08) Dear Provider, We have completed our review of the medical record and supporting documentation for the above-referenced SNF claim line. The submitted bill includes revenue code 0192 (therapy-level per-diem) for 18 days from 05/12/2026 through 06/08/2026. Finding: The medical record supports the billed therapy-level per-diem (rev. code 0192) for dates 05/12/2026 through 05/27/2026 (16 days). The record does NOT contain therapy-session documentation to support revenue code 0192 for dates 05/28/2026 through 06/08/2026; therefore 2 of the 18 billed days are unsupported at the 0192 per-diem level and must be adjusted. Basis: Documentation shows the patient was admitted for skilled PT/OT/nursing (History & Physical, 05/12/2026) and an interdisciplinary plan specifying PT/OT frequency (Interdisciplinary Plan of Care, 05/12/2026). Daily physical therapy progress notes document skilled PT sessions of approximately 90 minutes on each therapy day between 05/12/2026 and 05/27/2026 (see PT progress notes dated 05/13/2026 and 05/22/2026). The per-diem extraction tool returned null per-diem-level statements (i.e., no explicit facility downcoding statements), which is consistent when daily therapy minutes meet the billed level. However, the therapy-session extract and progress notes produced in the record for this audit contain no PT/OT session entries after 05/27/2026. In the absence of documented therapy minutes on 05/28/2026-06/08/2026, those dates cannot be sustained as therapy-level per-diem days. Correction: Reduce revenue code 0192 units from 18 to 16, corresponding to 05/12/2026-05/27/2026 (supported therapy-level days). The remaining billed days within 05/28/2026-06/08/2026 should be billed at the appropriate lower per-diem level (or non-covered) consistent with documentation (e.g., nursing-only per-diem) or be substantiated with additional records if you disagree with this adjustment. If you believe additional documentation (therapy progress notes, daily therapy logs, or other bedside therapy records) exists to support 0192 for 05/28/2026-06/08/2026, please submit those records for re-review. Sincerely, Clinical Audit Team
